subject: Fan Expo Boston 2026 Retrospective
overview: Host Stevie B presented a year-end retrospective featuring footage from Fan Expo Boston 2026 and offered personal acknowledgments following the passing of his mother.

items.title: Host Introduction and Acknowledgments
items.summary: Host Stevie B opened the year-end episode by thanking station staff, friends, and supporters for comforting him following the passing of his mother.

items.title: Fan Expo Boston 2026 Footage
items.summary: Video footage highlighted Stevie B's visit to Fan Expo Boston alongside his friend Lenny to meet featured celebrity guests.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Reflections
items.summary: Stevie B reflected on meeting convention voice actors, remembered performers who passed away in 2026, and thanked his family before concluding the broadcast.
